summary: Unauthenticated WebSocket PTY shell exposed by useTerminal middleware in UI-labeled package
details: Package @bananacool467/ui-tools presents itself as a MUI-like React UI component library but its main entry exports a `useTerminal` HTTP middleware factory that upgrades requests at `/terminal-stream` (path is configurable) to a WebSocket, spawns an interactive PTY via @lydell/node-pty (`bash` on POSIX, `powershell.exe` on Windows), and pipes bytes received from the WebSocket directly into the PTY's stdin. No authentication, origin check, or authorization gate is applied to the upgrade or to inbound messages. Any host that mounts this middleware exposes an unauthenticated remote shell to any party able to reach the endpoint, yielding full RCE on the process's host with the privileges of the Node.js server. The shell-server surface is undocumented in the README, which describes the package only as a UI component kit; dependencies (@lydell/node-pty, ws) and behavior contradict the advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
